description: Phantom Movies v1.5.9-beta.3 adds Firebase-backed user data sync for the phone app. Signed-in users now get a Firestore profile document, shared app settings sync, phone settings sync, and cloud-backed watch history/continue watching that merges with local history for faster loading.
body: Phantom Movies v1.5.9-beta.3 adds Firebase-backed user data sync for the phone app. Signed-in users now get a Firestore profile document, shared app settings sync, phone settings sync, and cloud-backed watch history/continue watching that merges with local history for faster loading.

releases.description: Phantom Movies v1.5.9-beta.2 starts the account/profile path for cross-device syncing. The first-open screen now offers email login, Google login, sign up, or skip; watch history is limited to signed-in users; and the home toolbar profile button opens login or profile based on auth state.
releases.body: Phantom Movies v1.5.9-beta.2 starts the account/profile path for cross-device syncing. The first-open screen now offers email login, Google login, sign up, or skip; watch history is limited to signed-in users; and the home toolbar profile button opens login or profile based on auth state.

releases.description: Phantom Movies v1.5.9-beta.1 aligns the app update system with the RivalsDB release flow, including beta topic notifications and root-hosted beta APK delivery for testers.
